$comment: Known divergences between the workflow spec (the reference), the Python tooling, and the engine. Phase 2 of docs/PROJECT_BLUEPRINT.md. The manifest may only ever get shorter: tools/spec_parity.py fails when a new difference appears, and also when a listed difference no longer occurs.
reference: the spec layer (.claude/) — it is what a candidate experiences

knownDifferences.summary: The engine scores three factors (skill, title, freshness); the spec scores four dimensions (technical, experience, behavioral, career).
knownDifferences.why: The engine's model is deterministic and the spec's needs judgment. Phase 5 resolves it by making the deterministic factors the engine's contribution and the four dimensions a versioned judgment input — not by picking one and dropping the other.

knownDifferences.summary: The spec has five verdict bands; the engine has three.
knownDifferences.why: The spec's bands are what a candidate reads in the shortlist. Phase 5 adopts the spec's five bands.

knownDifferences.summary: The engine's strong-fit threshold is 70; the spec's is 75.
knownDifferences.why: Same cause as engine-band-names. The spec's threshold is canonical.

knownDifferences.summary: The engine's good-fit threshold is 45; the spec's is 60.
knownDifferences.why: Same cause as engine-band-names. The spec's threshold is canonical.

knownDifferences.pattern: no gate for eligibility, notice-period, timezone-overlap
knownDifferences.summary: The engine has no eligibility (citizenship/residency), notice-period, or timezone-overlap gate. The spec defines all three, and the eligibility gate is a HARD STOP in the spec.
knownDifferences.why: The engine predates the spec's gate set and was written from hiring-filter needs rather than from the spec. Phase 5 adds the three gates; the eligibility gate is the highest-priority of them because the spec treats it as a hard stop.

knownDifferences.summary: The engine implements staleness as a gate that can FAIL; the spec implements it as a staleness flag in /rank Step 3 that never rejects.
knownDifferences.why: The spec never lets a stale posting be vetoed by age alone — it flags it and lets the candidate judge. The engine's gate is the stricter of the two and can remove a posting the spec would have shown. Phase 5 changes it to a flag.
